# TubeX.Chat

> > TubeX.Chat is a free AI-powered YouTube copilot that translates subtitles, analyzes videos, and enables multi-language learning with Gemini integration.

TubeX.Chat is an AI assistant platform designed to enhance YouTube viewing through intelligent video analysis, real-time subtitle translation, and multi-language support. The platform integrates with leading AI models including Google Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI, and is available as a Chrome extension for seamless browser integration.

## Key Topics

- YouTube AI Assistant
- Subtitle Translation
- Chrome Extension
- Gemini Integration
- Multi-Language Support
- AI Video Analysis
- Language Learning
- Free AI Tool
- Mind Map Generation

- Markdown Support

## Product & Features

- [TubeX - Your YouTube AI Copilot](https://tubex.chat/en): TubeX YouTube AI assistant with Gemini integration for subtitle translation and video analysis
